debug_drive_note: arm stiffness retained from old franka_fr3_duo.yaml; arm drive damping retuned in ClothDojo to [180,170,145,130,20,23,5] Nm*s/rad per side using sampled inertia and 1x-effort response comparisons. Full task retarget still requires its own validation. Gripper uses the accepted UR5e two-driver adaptation: kp=50, kd=5, effort=2.5 Nm each, driver armature=0.005 and passive armature=0.001; not vendor-certified.
deferred: motor inertia/gear ratio model and armature
packaging: Original workstation payload and arm/floor-mount/camera/TCP overrides preserved; components/robotiq_2f85.usdc replaces the gripper via components/robotiq_installation.usdc.
